question: Why OpenHOI3 left the Soviet 99. Strelkovaya Diviziya at 144 at 06:00 on 17 July 1941 where every run of the original pulls it to 619; and why the 78. and 117. Strelkovaya Diviziya differ at 10:00.

addresses.name: CUnit::GetMovementDestinationProvince
addresses.comment: Answers the province the unit is heading for, or null. Asks its order (CUnit +0xB0) slot 16 and bails on the save token 0x4E5 (`support_attack`), then resolves CUnit +0x2CC as a province id through the game state's province array. Bare `ret`, 52 callers. CAIUnit slot 76 uses it, falling back to current_province, when deciding how many units are already standing on a front. **Read whole on the listing 2026-11-15** (0x89AF00 to the three bare `ret`s at 0x89AFCD, 0x89AFF8 and 0x89B00B; FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 101): a support attack (order slot 16 = 0x4E5) answers null; +0x2CC above 0 answers that province; **with +0x2CC at 0, an order whose slot 24 says it is under way answers the order's own province (COrder +0xC)**, and only otherwise null. CUnit::AIStandDown zeroes +0x2CC at once but posts its null order as a command, so a unit the AI halts while on a strategic redeployment answers the redeployment's province for the rest of the pass. Seen: the Soviet 99. Strelkovaya Diviziya at 06:00 on 17 July 1941, halted at 144 by the line's second-ring branch, is seen by the pull as bound for 1589 - no position - and taken to 619 without the fullness test.
addresses.evidence: The body read on the listing; at CAIUnit_FillLinePositions' pull, the fullness test (0x4CA58C) and its pass (0x4CA758) logged on the running game: the 99. is passed with d 1589 for 619, after CEU3AI::MoveUnit's stand-down for it (0x49A93E) had been reached with +0x2CC 1589, and +0x2CC read 0 at its next move.

addresses.name: CUnit_HasHaltableOrder
addresses.comment: Whether a unit's order (CUnit +0xB0) is one a halt should cancel: false for a support attack (slot 16 = 0x4E5) and carrier protection (0x56C), else the order's slot 24 (under way). Read whole, 0x89AEC0 to the bare `ret` at 0x89AEFD. Asked by CEU3AI::MoveUnit at 0x89A92B when a unit is sent to the province it stands in with +0x2CC at 0: a yes stands it down (CUnit::AIStandDown), a no leaves it. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 101.

slots_noted.0x49AF00: Already recorded; this revises the comment only.
